response.justification: Bogdan brings staff-level seniority, strong TypeScript and cloud expertise, and is currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq—directly aligned with the role's focus. However, his resume lacks evidence of building production AI/ML solutions, does not demonstrate Python proficiency (a required primary technology), and shows no hands-on experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLMs. While his current trajectory is promising, the minimal demonstrated GenAI expertise and recent entry into AI (4 months ago) make it difficult to verify the required 8+ years of AI solution-building experience.
strengths: Current role at re:cinq focuses on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators—directly aligned with role's technical priorities
Staff-level seniority with 16+ years shipping production systems and proven ability to architect complex solutions across multiple domains
Strong TypeScript/Node.js and cloud platform expertise (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker) with demonstrated full-stack engineering versatility
concerns: No explicit evidence of building production AI/ML solutions or working with vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLMs despite 16+ years in software
Python proficiency not mentioned in resume, yet listed as a primary required technology for the role
AI infrastructure role began only 4 months ago, limiting ability to verify the required 8+ years of GenAI production experience
